snippet.description:
🔥 SCENE Official Trailer Reaction in Tamil by Vasu and Swathi! 😱 Suriya, Nazriya Nazim and Naslen star in this highly anticipated Tamil movie directed by Jithu Madhavan. Watch our first reaction to the SCENE Tamil movie trailer, Suriya's unique police avatar, and the exciting combination of Tamil and Malayalam cinema talent!

Welcome back to Tamil Family Reacts! ❤️ In this video, Vasu and Swathi watch and react to the official trailer of SCENE, the upcoming Tamil film starring Suriya, Nazriya Nazim and Naslen. With Malayalam filmmaker Jithu Madhavan making his Tamil directorial debut, SCENE has attracted attention from movie fans across Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

🎬 ABOUT SCENE

SCENE is an upcoming Tamil action-comedy entertainer written and directed by Jithu Madhavan. The film stars Suriya as DSP Inbaraj, an unconventional police officer whose investigation brings him together with an unusual and troublesome team. The story promises a mix of police investigation, action, comedy and unpredictable situations.

The movie features a noteworthy combination of performers from the Tamil and Malayalam film industries. Suriya leads the cast, while Nazriya Nazim and Naslen add to the film's cross-industry appeal. The project also brings Malayalam director Jithu Madhavan and composer Sushin Shyam into Tamil cinema.

🎭 Naslen
🎭 Anandraj

🎥 Cinematography by Vineeth Augustian

🏢 Production banners: 2D Entertainment and Zhagaram Studios

What do Vasu and Swathi think about Suriya's police character? How does the trailer introduce the movie's action, comedy and investigation elements? Does the combination of Suriya, Nazriya Nazim, Naslen and Jithu Madhavan make SCENE an exciting upcoming theatrical experience?

Watch our complete trailer reaction to discover our genuine impressions, favourite moments and expectations for the movie. Join us as we discuss the trailer, the cast, the performances, the music and the overall feel of this highly anticipated Tamil release.

💥 WHY SCENE IS GETTING ATTENTION

SCENE brings together Suriya's star power, Jithu Madhavan's distinctive filmmaking background and the growing popularity of Malayalam actor Naslen. For viewers who enjoy Tamil action-comedy films and Malayalam cinema, this combination makes the film particularly interesting.

The movie is also generating interest because of its cross-industry cast and crew. Suriya's role as DSP Inbaraj provides the central character angle, while the ensemble cast creates curiosity about how the investigation and comedy will unfold.

SCENE is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical release on 6 November 2026. Stay tuned to official movie channels and announcements for further updates.

snippet.title: Apni Mang Suhagan Ho - | Amitabh, Shah Rukh, Kajol, Kareena, Hrithik | Karwa Chauth Special
snippet.description:
Celebrate the beautiful spirit of Karwa Chauth with Apni Mang Suhagan Ho from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham in this special Lyrical Video.

Featuring the unforgettable voices of Amit Kumar, Sonu Nigam, Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan & Kavita Krishnamurthy, with music by Jatin-Lalit and lyrics by Sameer Anjaan, this timeless melody beautifully captures the love, devotion and togetherness of Karwa Chauth.

Relive the iconic moments of Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol and let this evergreen Bollywood melody make your Karwa Chauth celebrations even more special. ✨🎶

#apnimangsuhaganho #karwachauth #karwachauthspecial #karwachauthsongs #kabhikhushikabhiegham #shahrukhkhan #kajol #jatinlalit #sameeranjaan #amitkumar #sonunigam #alkayagnik #uditnarayan #kavitakrishnamurthy #lyricalvideo #bollywoodsongs #hindisongs #romanticsongs #karwachauthspecialsongs

Credits:
Song Name: Apni Mang Suhagan Ho
Movie: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
Singers: Amit Kumar, Sonu Nigam, Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan, Kavita Krishnamurthy
Composer: Jatin-Lalit
Lyricist: Sameer Anjaan

Lyrics:
Apni maang suhaagan ho
Sang hamesha sajan ho
Aake meri duniya mein
Vapas na jaana
Sehra baand ke mahi
Tu mere ghar aana
Oye soni kithi soni aaj tu lagdi ve
Bas mera saath yeh jodi teri sajdi ve
Roop aaisa suhana tera
Chaand bhi hai deewana tera
Ja re ja oh joothe
Teri galla hum na maane
Kyun taareefein karta hai tu
Hum toh sab kuch jaane
Ho o o o … meri dil ki dua yeh kahe
Teri jodi salamat rahe
Oh sajan ji
Haan sajan ji
Yunhi beete saara jeevan saath mein
Bole chudiyan
Bole kangana
Haai main ho gaya tera saajna
Tere bin jiyo naiyyo lagda
Main te margaiyan
Lehja lehja … soniye lehja lehja
Dil lehja lehja … ho ho o
Lehja lehja … soniye lehja lehja
Dil lehja lehja … ho ho o
Aaja Heeriye … o ja ja Ranjhana
O aaja Heeriye … ja ja Ranjhana
Lehja lehja … dil lehja lehja
Lehja lehja … dil lehja lehja
Lehja lehja … soniye lehja lehja
Lehja lehja … dil lehja lehja
Lehja lehja … soniye lehja lehja
Aa aa … kabhi khushi kabhie gham
Na judaa honge hum

Listen to the sacred chanting of Govinda Namalu with Telugu lyrics, a powerful devotional offering to Lord Venkateswara. Chanting “Govinda Govinda” is believed to bring peace, remove obstacles, and fill life with divine blessings.

This collection of popular Venkateswara Swamy bhakti songs helps devotees connect deeply with Lord Balaji of Tirumala. The Telugu lyrics make it easy to follow along and immerse yourself in devotion during prayer, meditation, or daily listening.

snippet.title: Karwa Chauth Ki Aarti | Karwa Chauth Song | Karwa Chauth Aarti | Om Jai Karwa Maiya | Karwa Chauth
snippet.description:
Welcome sacred marital bliss, long life, and eternal harmony into your family with the divine recitation of "Karwa Chauth Ki Aarti" (ॐ जय करवा मैया - Karwa Mata Ki Aarti). Dedicated to Karwa Mata, Goddess Parvati, and Lord Shiva, this auspicious devotional Aarti cleanses your home of negative energies, removes domestic misunderstandings, and fills your surroundings with pure positive vibrations, love, and divine grace.

Performing and listening to Om Jai Karwa Maiya on the auspicious occasion of Karwa Chauth and evening puja rituals brings the protective shelter of Mother Divine directly into your married life. As the supreme symbol of devotion, sacrifice, and marital fidelity (Pativrata Dharma), Karwa Mata dissolves hardships, blesses spouses with longevity, good health, and mutual respect, and surrounds the household with lasting peace and prosperity.

Spiritual Significance & Meaning:
This sacred Aarti offers humble devotion to Karwa Mata, seeking Her maternal benevolence to safeguard one's husband's life and ensure continuous happiness in marriage. By lighting a sacred deepam, listening to the Karwa Chauth Vrat Katha, and singing this Aarti after sighting the moon and offering Arghya, devotees express total faith and receive divine protection against all adversities.

Key Benefits of Chanting & Listening:
• Bestows long life, vibrant health, and safety for one's husband (Akhand Saubhagya).
• Cultivates deep mutual love, understanding, and lifelong marital harmony.
• Clears away domestic stress, anxiety, and negative household vibrations.
• Brings the benevolent grace and blessings of Karwa Mata and Goddess Gauri.
• Essential devotional Aarti for Karwa Chauth Vrat, evening puja, and Moon Arghya rituals.

Best Time to Listen:
• During Karwa Chauth evening Vrat Puja while narrating the Karwa Chauth Katha.
• At night during the sighting of the moon (Chandra Darshan) and Arghya rituals.
• Every morning and evening during Navratri and dedicated Gauri/Parvati puja days.

Album: Aarzoo

Lyrics:

Chandni rat, taro ki barat hai
Dil ki mehfil sajane mein
Kya der hai, kya der hai
Dhadkane dil ki shehnaiya ban gayi
Abb toh sajan ke aane mein
Kya der hai, kya der hai

Meri zindagi mera pyar yad aa raha hai
Aanewala hai jo, woh yad aa raha hai
Sajan sajan teri dulhan tujhko pukare aaja
Aakar mere hatho mein mehndi tu hi racha ja
Sajan sajan teri dulhan
Tujhko pukare aaja
Aakar mere hatho mein
Mehndi tu hi racha ja
Aa ja, aa ja, aa ja

Meri zindagi mera pyar yad aa raha hai
Aanewala hai jo, woh yad aa raha hai
Sajan sajan teri dulhan tujhko pukare aaja
Aakar mere hatho mein
Mehndi tu hi racha ja
Aa ja, aa ja, aa ja

Payal kajal kangan daman sare tujhe bulaye
Aa ja sajan aa ja tere apne tujhe bulaye
Aa ja, aa ja, sajan aa ja
Mere mehbub, mere hamsafar
Tujhko kya pata, hai tujhe kya khabar,
Ehsan tere kitne hai mujhpar
Rab pe yakin hai jitna, utna hai tujhpar
Aa ja, aa ja, aa ja

Mera mehbub mera sanam aa raha hai
Ham toh marhi chuke the,
Phir janam aa raha hai
Sajan sajan teri dulhan tujhko pukare aa ja
Aakar mere hatho mein
Mehndi tu hi racha ja
Aa ja, aa ja, aa ja

Chunri meri rangin huyi hai
Tere rang se sajan
Aakar rang de mera
Ang ang apne rang se sajan
Aa ja aa ja sajan aa ja
Tumse wafaye bahut main karungi
Kasam teri abb yeh dil kisi ko na dungi
Aa tujhe bata du, mere dil mein kya hai
Dil lenewale tujhe jaan apni dungi
Aa ja, aa ja, aa ja

Dhadkane badh rahi hai,
Woh karib aa raha hai
Khushnasibi banke mera
Woh nasib aa raha hai
Sajan sajan teri dulhan
Tujhko pukare aa ja
Aakar mere hatho mein
Mehndi tu hi racha ja

Chandni raat, taro ki barat hai
Dil ki mehfil sajne mein
Kya der hai, kya der hai
Dhadkane dil ki shehnaiya ban gayi
Abb toh sajan ke aane mein
Kya der hai, kya der hai.

snippet.title: ಈ ಕನ್ನಡ ಮಣ್ಣನು ಮರಿಬೇಡ - Lyrical | Ee Kannada Mannanu Maribeda | Solillada Saradara | Ambareesh
snippet.description:
Celebrate the pride, culture, heritage and richness of Kannada Nadu with the evergreen song "Ee Kannada Mannanu Maribeda" from the classic Kannada movie "Solillada Saradara".

Featuring the legendary Rebel Star Dr. Ambareesh, beautiful Malashri and Bhavya, this memorable Kannada song is beautifully sung by the legendary S. P. Balasubrahmanyam (SPB), with music and lyrics by the musical maestro Hamsalekha.

A heartfelt tribute to Kannada language, Karnataka's glorious history, culture, traditions and the pride of being Kannadiga. This timeless melody reminds every Kannadiga to respect and cherish our motherland and mother tongue.

🌺 ಕನ್ನಡವೇ ಸತ್ಯ, ಕನ್ನಡವೇ ನಿತ್ಯ!

ನಮ್ಮ ಕನ್ನಡ ನಾಡಿನ ಹೆಮ್ಮೆ, ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ, ಪರಂಪರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭಾಷೆಯ ಮಹತ್ವವನ್ನು ಸಾರುವ ಸುಂದರ ಗೀತೆ. ಕನ್ನಡ ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ಅಭಿಮಾನವನ್ನು ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ಕನ್ನಡಿಗನ ಹೃದಯದಲ್ಲೂ ಮೂಡಿಸುವ ಎಂದೆಂದಿಗೂ ಮರೆಯಲಾಗದ ಹಾಡು.

Watch Our Master Music Collection Songs Superhit Tamil Movie Song Priyamaanavale is a 2000 Indian Tamil-language romantic drama film directed by K. Selva Bharathy. The film stars Vijay and Simran in the lead roles with S. P. Balasubrahmanyam, Vivek and Radhika Chaudhari in supporting roles. It revolves around a working woman in a struggling family marrying a billionaire for the upbringing of her poor family and the distress she receives from her NRI husband with non-Indian cultural shades but later realises about the importance of Indian culture and marriage and then becomes a loving and caring husband. This film is the Tamil remake of the 1996 Telugu film Pavitra Bandham, with SPB reprising his role from the original.
